This section contains the contents of the repository's files.# KIET KRA Tracker & Universal Accreditation Reporting System ## Master Architecture, Domain Model & Developer Playbook
> **Target Audience:** AI Coding Agents, Pair-Programmers, and Developers. > **Mission:** Provide an instant 360° mental model of the entire repository without consuming token budgets or requiring full-repo analysis.
---
## 1. Executive System Overview
### 1.1 Problem Statement & Solution - **Previous State:** KIET University historically tracked ~50 Key Result Areas (KRAs) across 13 engineering/management departments using a complex, error-prone manual Excel workbook. This caused data inconsistencies, dead Google Drive evidence links, unscaled target thresholds, and manual delays during NBA/NAAC accreditation audits. - **Current System:** A decoupled, role-based, intranet-hosted web application that: 1. Standardizes all ~50 KRAs into structured data schemas and archetypes. 2. Dynamically scales numeric targets based on department faculty/student strength (`target = base_target * faculty_strength`). 3. Enforces strict bi-monthly submission cycles with automated email reminders and administrative deadline exceptions. 4. Provides a split-screen live report builder for faculty/deans with pixel-perfect letterhead preview. 5. Houses a dual-engine document exporter: produces official, audit-ready **PDFs** (via `xhtml2pdf`) and editable **Word (.docx)** documents (via `python-docx`). 6. Stores raw JSON evidence and file attachments locally on the college intranet for 100% data privacy.
### 1.2 Technology Stack | Layer | Technologies | |---|---| | **Frontend** | Next.js 14+ (App Router), React 18, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Axios, Lucide Icons | | **Backend** | Python 3.12, Django 5+, Django REST Framework (DRF), Celery 5+, Redis (Broker), SQLite (local dev) / PostgreSQL (production) | | **Document Generation** | `python-docx` (Word engine), `xhtml2pdf` + HTML templates (PDF engine) | | **Authentication** | Session & Token-based DRF Authentication with CSRF protection | | **Infrastructure** | Docker, Docker Compose, Nginx (local campus intranet deployment) |

## 3. Data Models & Relational Architecture
### 3.1 `core` App Models 1. **`Department`** - `name`: string (e.g. `'Computer Science & Engineering'`, `'ECE'`, `'IT'`). - `faculty_strength`: integer (used as multiplier for dynamic KRA annual targets). - `student_strength`: integer. 2. **`AccreditationCriteria`** - `nba_code`: string (e.g. `'NBA Criterion 2'`). - `naac_code`: string (e.g. `'NAAC Criterion 1.1'`). 3. **`KRAMetric`** - `serial_number`: string (e.g. `'KRA 1'`, `'KRA 7'`). - `activity_description`: text. - `target_type`: `'Numeric'` | `'Percentage'` | `'Boolean'`. - `annual_target`: string (number or descriptive threshold). - `criteria`: ForeignKey → `AccreditationCriteria`.
### 3.2 `accounts` App Models 1. **`User` (extends `AbstractUser`)** - `role`: `'SUPER_ADMIN'` (VC / Director / IQAC) or `'DEAN'` (Department Dean/HOD). - `department`: OneToOneField → `Department` (null for Super Admin). 2. **`AuditLog`** - Tracks actions, user, timestamp, IP, before_state, after_state for compliance.
### 3.3 `tracker` App Models 1. **`BiMonthlyCycle`** - `academic_year`: e.g. `'2026-2027'`. - `cycle_name`: choices = `['JUL-AUG', 'SEP-OCT', 'NOV-DEC', 'JAN-FEB', 'MAR-APR', 'MAY-JUN']`. - `deadline`: DateField (automated emails triggered 5 days prior). - `is_active`: boolean. 2. **`CycleException`** - Allows reopening a cycle for a specific department beyond standard deadline. - `cycle`, `department`, `open_until`, `reason`, `opened_by`. 3. **`Achievement` (Central Entity)** - `department`: FK → `Department`. - `kra_metric`: FK → `KRAMetric`. - `cycle`: FK → `BiMonthlyCycle`. - `status`: `'DRAFT'` | `'SUBMITTED'` | `'REJECTED'` | `'APPROVED'`. - `numeric_value`: DecimalField (for numeric metrics). - `remarks`: text. - `review_comment`: text (rejection reason or admin feedback). - `custom_data`: **JSONField** (Stores the entire structured form state for the specific KRA template, including tabular rows, coordinator names, dates, surveys, etc.). - `submitted_by`: FK → `User`. - **`dynamic_target` property**: Calculates `base_target * department.faculty_strength` dynamically. 4. **`UploadedEvidenceFile`** - Attached to `Achievement`. - `document_type`, `file`, `filename`, `file_size_kb`, `uploaded_at`, `uploaded_by`.
---
## 4. The KRA Form & Universal Reporting System
Every KRA submission requires structured evidence that can be previewed live and exported into official KIET University documents.
### 4.1 The 10 Universal KRA Archetypes To avoid writing 50 separate forms, all ~50 KRAs map onto 10 standard archetypes handled by `KRATemplateDataForm.tsx` & `SmartUniversalReportBuilder.tsx`: 1. **VAC / Certificate Course** (Course title, duration, enrolled count, syllabus, coordinator). 2. **Curriculum Feedback & Action Taken** (Stakeholder surveys, percentage satisfaction, actions). 3. **Research, Publications & Patents** (Paper title, journal/conference, Scopus/SCI, DOI, authors). 4. **Workshops, FDPs & Conferences Organized** (Event title, dates, speakers, participants, budget). 5. **Student Competitions & Hackathons** (Event name, team members, prize won, level). 6. **Industry MOUs & Supported Labs** (Company name, validity, scope, outcomes). 7. **Placements & Higher Studies** (Student list, company, CTC, university admitted). 8. **Exam Results & Remedial Actions** (Subject, pass %, fail count, corrective plan). 9. **Mentoring & Student Counseling** (Mentee batches, sessions conducted, issues resolved). 10. **Institutional Governance & Committees** (Committee name, meetings held, key minutes).
### 4.2 Split Screen Architecture - Located in `frontend/components/dean/SplitTemplateEditor.tsx`. - **Left Panel:** Interactive form (`KRATemplateDataForm`, `SmartVACReportBuilder`, or `SmartKRA7ReportBuilder`). As the user types, the state updates in real time. - **Right Panel:** Live Official Document Preview (`OfficialKRAReportPreview.tsx`). Matches the exact layout, maroon/blue KIET header, metadata tables, dynamic table rows, photo spaces, and sign-off blocks. - **Top Actions:** - `Save Draft`: Persists state to `custom_data` with status `DRAFT`. - `Submit for Approval`: Validates required fields, sets status `SUBMITTED`. - `Export PDF`: Calls `/api/tracker/export-kra-pdf/`. - `Export DOCX`: Calls `/api/tracker/export-kra-docx/`.
---
## 5. Dual-Engine Document Export Architecture
Both PDF and Word exports match official KIET University document formatting: - **Header:** KIET University Logo, Department Name, Academic Year, Cycle, Date. - **Title Block:** Official KRA Code, Formal Accreditation Title, Prepared By, Designation. - **Summary Metadata Table:** Coordinator details, venue, dates, target vs achieved. - **Data Table:** Dynamic tabular rows matching the specific KRA (with shaded header rows). - **Survey / Rating Grid (if applicable):** Questions, Likert scales, averages. - **Action Taken / Narrative:** Descriptive paragraphs and remedial plans. - **Signatures Block:** Faculty Coordinator, Head of Department, Dean of Faculty.
### 5.1 PDF Exporter (`tracker/views.py` + `xhtml2pdf`) - **Endpoint:** `POST /api/tracker/export-kra-pdf/` - **Template:** `tracker/templates/tracker/kra_generic_report.html` - **Mechanism:** Takes the submitted JSON data, renders HTML with embedded CSS, converts to PDF stream using `xhtml2pdf.pisa`.
### 5.2 Word (.docx) Exporter (`tracker/kra_reports.py` + `python-docx`) - **Endpoint:** `POST /api/tracker/export-kra-docx/` - **Mechanism:** Builds a clean, editable Word `.docx` file programmatically: - Header styling with KIET Blue (`RGBColor(0, 35, 111)`) and Maroon (`RGBColor(98, 36, 35)`). - Shaded table headers with custom borders. - Formatted paragraphs, bullets, and table widths.
---

## 7. Developer Playbook: How to Make Changes
### 7.1 How to Add or Modify a Specialized KRA Form 1. Create or update the form component in `frontend/components/kra-forms/MyKRAForm.tsx`. 2. Register the component in `frontend/components/kra-forms/KRAFormRegistry.tsx`: ```tsx import MyKRAForm from './MyKRAForm';
// Inside getKRAFormComponent(kraNumber): if (cleanNum === 15) { return <MyKRAForm {...props} />; } ``` 3. Ensure the form saves its data into `achievement.custom_data` via `onSave(formData)`.
### 7.2 How to Adjust Report Layouts - **For PDF:** Edit `tracker/templates/tracker/kra_generic_report.html`. Note: `xhtml2pdf` supports standard CSS 2.1 (avoid flexbox/grid; use standard `<table>` layout). - **For DOCX:** Edit `tracker/kra_reports.py`. Check `generate_kra_report_docx(data)`. - **For React Live Preview:** Edit `frontend/components/kra-forms/OfficialKRAReportPreview.tsx`.
### 7.3 How to Run Backend Locally ```powershell # From root directory: python -m venv .venv .\.venv\Scripts\activate pip install -r requirements.txt python manage.py migrate python manage.py runserver ```
### 7.4 How to Run Frontend Locally ```powershell cd frontend npm install npm run dev # Accessible at http://localhost:3000 ```

## 1. Tech Stack - **Frontend:** Next.js (App Router), React, Tailwind CSS - **Backend:** Python, Django, Django REST Framework (DRF) - **Database:** PostgreSQL - **Background Tasks:** Celery, Redis (for email reminders) - **Deployment:** Docker, Docker Compose, Nginx (Local Intranet)
## 2. Architecture Overview The application follows a decoupled client-server architecture interacting via REST APIs. - The Next.js frontend is served locally. - The Django backend exposes secured endpoints. - Celery workers continuously monitor the Postgres DB for deadlines and use Redis as a message broker to dispatch emails.
## 3. Proposed Folder Structure ```text /kiet-kra ├── /frontend │ ├── /app # Next.js App Router │ ├── /components # Reusable UI (Tailwind) │ ├── /lib # API calls (Axios) │ └── package.json ├── /backend │ ├── /core # Django base app & Auth │ ├── /tracker # KRA & Achievement logic │ ├── /reports # Template Engine & PDF generation │ ├── manage.py │ └── requirements.txt ├── /nginx # Reverse proxy config └── docker-compose.yml ```# Architecture & Tech Decisions
## 1. Why Next.js over React SPA? - **Decision:** Use Next.js App Router. - **Reason:** Provides built-in routing, better performance via server components, and is the enterprise standard for React. It handles heavy data fetching (for Admin dashboards) more efficiently than standard client-side React.
## 2. Why Django & PostgreSQL? - **Decision:** Use Django with DRF and Postgres. - **Reason:** Django offers high security out-of-the-box, a built-in admin panel for emergency database management, and a robust ORM that easily handles the complex relational mapping between Departments, dynamic KRAs, and bi-monthly achievements. Postgres enforces strict data integrity.
## 3. Why Local Intranet via Docker? - **Decision:** Host on local college servers instead of AWS/Cloud. - **Reason:** Ensures 100% data privacy. By using Docker, we avoid "it works on my machine" issues. IT staff can deploy the entire stack with a single `docker-compose up` command.
## 4. Why Celery & Redis for Emails? - **Decision:** Offload email tasks to Celery. - **Reason:** If we put a sleep timer or a synchronous loop in Django to check for deadlines 5 days prior, the server will crash. Celery runs asynchronously in the background, checking the database daily without interrupting the main web application.
## 5. Why Live Preview Templates? - **Decision:** Generate PDFs on the fly based on form data. - **Reason:** Ensures standard formatting across all 13 departments. Faculty no longer have to design their own Word documents; they just fill a form and the system generates the official compliance document.
## 6. Why Data-Driven Evidence over Manual File Uploads? - **Decision:** The Evidence model stores raw JSON data (document_data) instead of requiring an explicit file upload. - **Reason:** Faculty should be able to edit their reports later without having to re-upload PDFs. # REPOMIX AI CODING INSTRUCTIONS ## Project: KIET KRA Tracker & Universal Accreditation Reporting System
Welcome AI Agent. This file is an optimized Repomix bundle containing the core architecture, data schemas, backend endpoints, and frontend components for the KIET KRA Tracker.
### 1. Essential Mental Model - This is an enterprise web app replacing an Excel sheet for 13 academic departments tracking ~50 Key Result Areas (KRAs) for NBA & NAAC accreditation. - **Backend:** Django 5 + Django REST Framework + Celery/Redis. Base apps: `core`, `accounts`, `tracker`. - **Frontend:** Next.js 14+ (App Router), React 18, Tailwind CSS, TypeScript in `frontend/`. - **Key Models:** - `KRAMetric` (`serial_number`, `annual_target`, `target_type`) - `Department` (`faculty_strength`, `student_strength`) - `BiMonthlyCycle` (`JUL-AUG`, `SEP-OCT`, etc., `deadline`) - `Achievement` (links `department` + `kra_metric` + `cycle`; stores structured form data in `custom_data` JSONField) - **Target Scaling:** `dynamic_target = base_target * department.faculty_strength` (for Numeric KRAs).
### 2. KRA Form & Report Pipeline - Deans fill KRA reports using `SplitTemplateEditor.tsx` (left: form, right: live official preview `OfficialKRAReportPreview.tsx`). - Forms are routed via `frontend/components/kra-forms/KRAFormRegistry.tsx`. - Form state is stored directly in `achievement.custom_data`. - Dual Document Exporting: - **PDF:** `POST /api/tracker/export-kra-pdf/` -> `tracker/views.py` renders `tracker/templates/tracker/kra_generic_report.html` via `xhtml2pdf`. - **Word DOCX:** `POST /api/tracker/export-kra-docx/` -> `tracker/kra_reports.py` builds `.docx` via `python-docx`.
### 3. Key Conventions for Modifications - When adding/modifying forms: update `frontend/components/kra-forms/` and register in `KRAFormRegistry.tsx`. - When updating report formats: maintain consistency between `OfficialKRAReportPreview.tsx`, `kra_generic_report.html`, and `kra_reports.py`. - Preserve existing comments and docstrings. - Always check `AI_PROJECT_CONTEXT.md` at the top of this bundle for deep architectural references.
